import unittest
from solution import resolve_inventory_request


class ResolveInventoryRequestTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_static_routes(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_inventory_request('GET', '/items/'), ('list_items', {}))
        self.assertEqual(resolve_inventory_request('POST', '/items/add/'), ('create_item', {}))

    def test_id_routes_and_id_type(self):
        cases = [
            ('GET', '/items/1/', 'get_item'),
            ('GET', '/items/987654321/', 'get_item'),
            ('PUT', '/items/42/', 'update_item'),
            ('DELETE', '/items/7/', 'delete_item'),
        ]
        for method, path, action in cases:
            result = resolve_inventory_request(method, path)
            self.assertEqual(result, (action, {'id': int(path.split('/')[2])}))
            self.assertIs(type(result[1]['id']), int)

    def test_nonmatching_routes(self):
        invalid = [
            ('get', '/items/'), ('PATCH', '/items/1/'),
            ('POST', '/items/1/'), ('GET', '/items/add/'),
            ('GET', '/items/0/'), ('GET', '/items/00/'), ('GET', '/items/01/'),
            ('GET', '/items/-1/'), ('GET', '/items/+1/'), ('GET', '/items/1.0/'),
            ('GET', '/items/ 1/'), ('GET', '/items/1'), ('GET', 'items/1/'),
            ('GET', '/items//1/'), ('GET', '//items/1/'),
            ('GET', '/items/1//'), ('GET', '/items/1/extra/'),
            ('GET', '/items/1/?x=1'), ('GET', '/items/1/#x'),
            ('GET ', '/items/'), ('GET', '/items'), ('GET', '/Items/'),
        ]
        for method, path in invalid:
            self.assertIsNone(resolve_inventory_request(method, path), (method, path))

    def test_type_errors(self):
        for method, path in ((None, '/items/'), ('GET', None), (1, '/items/'), ('GET', b'/items/')):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                resolve_inventory_request(method, path)

    def test_returned_dicts_are_fresh(self):
        first = resolve_inventory_request('GET', '/items/3/')
        second = resolve_inventory_request('GET', '/items/3/')
        self.assertIsNot(first[1], second[1])
        first[1]['changed'] = True
        self.assertEqual(second, ('get_item', {'id': 3}))
        a = resolve_inventory_request('GET', '/items/')
        b = resolve_inventory_request('GET', '/items/')
        self.assertIsNot(a[1], b[1])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
